etsy.title: Kindness Leprechaun Kit, St Patricks Day Countdown for Kids, Leprechaun Letter and 14 Kindness Notes, Gold Coin Reward Cards
etsy.description:
The leprechaun tradition, minus the green-glitter mess. ☘️

A cheeky little leprechaun leaves one kind mission a day for the 14 days before St. Patrick's Day. Read the note together, do it together, color a gold coin. Five minutes a day.

WHAT'S INSIDE (18 pages)
• Leprechaun arrival letter
• Leprechaun passport
• 14 kindness notes (4 per page)
• Gold coin tracker
• 2 lifesaver letters
• Halfway letter
• 4 gold coin reward cards
• Goodbye letter + "I Was Kind!" certificate
• 8 blank notes + 30 tiny kindness ideas

AGES: 3 to 8.

PAIR IT WITH: Kindness Cupid (February) and Kindness Bunny (Easter) in our shop.

INSTANT DIGITAL DOWNLOAD. No physical item will be shipped.
You get 2 PDFs: US Letter and A4. Print at home or at a print shop. For personal use only.

Designed by our small shop, AureliaVenn, with the help of AI tools.
